svg.title: 5040 — luminous glass vector logo
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the supplied 5040 artwork: green 5 and red 0 above blue 4 and amber 0. Smooth colored glass, glowing neon rims and white numeral outlines. Transparent background. All artwork uses editable vector paths, circles, gradients and SVG filters. No embedded raster images, external assets or font dependencies.
